text: [image: A Florida legislative chamber]05Equal justice under the law“Equal justice is not a political position. It is the foundation of a free society.” The rule of law applying equally regardless of skin color, wealth, or fame.Read the platform

[image: A North Florida spring on a summer afternoon]01Clean water and clean air“Life begins with clean water and clean air. Without them, nothing else is possible.” Defending nature’s rights as a practical foundation for human health and survival.Read the platform

[image: A community gathering in the district]04Freedom to, not only freedom from“Freedom to learn. Freedom to thrive. Freedom to speak, to criticize, to praise, to love. Freedom to control your own body. Freedom from fear.”Read the platform

[image: A packed community meeting in the district]02Healthcare that does not bankrupt families“I support single-payer, Medicare-for-all reform. It saves money, eliminates unnecessary middlemen, and treats healthcare as what it is: a basic condition of a decent life.”Read the platform

[image: Farm rows and a home in District 10]03Building that does not poison the ground“Life means building and planning in ways that do not poison the ground beneath our feet. Sustainable building design is not a luxury. In Florida, it is a necessity.”Read the platform
